scope: Preparation only; no GCP VM, driver installation, data transfer or optimizer work
migration_requirements: Verify compatible host driver and container GPU visibility before model loading
Keep exact pinned image, vendored Moshi code and model source; no opportunistic package upgrades
Bind copied archive and candidate checkpoint to approved inventories and SHA256 hashes
Keep weights, optimizer, Python/NumPy/Torch/CUDA RNG, source data, manifests and receipts on persistent disk
Use local SSD only for disposable caches; provider timed stop can discard local SSD
Cold independently restore the full training state and run existing numerical/native approval checks before new optimizer work
Maintain a provider-native hard deadline and active cost guard; quota is not proof of capacity
Do not overlap another training job with the existing Runpod trainer
